verdict.rationale: Paperspace's marketing explicitly claims 'Low-cost GPUs with per-second billing' and provides auto-shutdown to stop machines after inactivity, supporting the story on paper. However, community reports contradict the 'only billed while running' promise: one user was charged despite their account being frozen/unused, and another notes a $9/mo Pro tier that bundles flat non-per-usage GPU hours rather than strict per-second metering. missing for 10: independent verification of second-level billing accuracy, resolution of the billing-while-locked-out complaint, and clarity on how flat-rate tiers reconcile with per-second billing claims.
